site_geometry.replacement_lineage: FAI-NFCF-T-11 in BALA1 and FAI-NFCF-TB26 in BALA2/BALA3 are one conceptual lineage
site_geometry.physical_site_coordinate: median decimalLatitude and median decimalLongitude across eligible Event rows for that physical site code
site_geometry.conceptual_lineage_coordinate: median of physical-site coordinate representatives belonging to the conceptual lineage
site_geometry.island_coordinate: median conceptual-lineage latitude and longitude within the three-letter island code

graph_operator.name: Gabriel graph on frozen island centroids
graph_operator.reason: parameter-free local-neighbour graph that contains the Euclidean MST, avoids choosing a distance threshold from occurrence response, and remains connected for nondegenerate point sets
graph_operator.projection_for_adjacency: equirectangular kilometres using the mean latitude of the seven frozen island centroids
graph_operator.gabriel_edge_rule: connect i-j iff no third island centroid lies strictly inside the circle having i-j as diameter
graph_operator.edge_weight: great-circle haversine kilometres between frozen island centroids
graph_operator.lambda: median original Gabriel-edge haversine length in kilometres
